purpose: Prospectively test whether task-specific support, refutation, bridge, and cross-document role prompts add evidence-selection value beyond generic FRC roles and reproducible retrieval baselines.

hypothesis_origin.interpretation: Generic role scores were almost redundant with generic retrieval features on MuSiQue; a new independent dataset and task-specific role prompts are required.

source.name: HoVer: A Dataset for Many-Hop Fact Extraction and Claim Verification
source.all_rows_policy: Use every structurally valid dev row without sampling or replacement.
source.post_download_registration: Before neural scoring, freeze exact file hashes, schema census, case/hop/label counts, top-20 candidate resolution, gold-document candidate ceiling, database schema, chunk distributions, and exclusions.

frozen_adapter.query: The public HoVer claim text only.
frozen_adapter.official_candidate_pool: Take the first 20 official TF-IDF retrieved document titles in released order before any gold join; do not add missing gold documents.
frozen_adapter.candidate_source_text: Normalized Wikipedia title plus normalized full article text from the official HoVer SQLite database.
frozen_adapter.candidate_identity: After top-20 membership is fixed, deduplicate resolved titles and sort source documents by SHA-256 of normalized title before assigning label-neutral source ordinals.
frozen_adapter.gold_unit: Each unique normalized supporting-document title referenced by public supporting facts is one required evidence unit; all chunks of that source inherit the unit only during evaluation.
frozen_adapter.candidate_ceiling: Report per-case and aggregate fraction of gold supporting-document units present among resolved official top-20 candidates.
frozen_adapter.structural_exclusions: Exclude only invalid required field types, empty claim/id, duplicate public IDs, no supporting-document gold, fewer than two resolved candidate documents, or cross-label title ambiguity; never replace excluded rows.

frozen_scoring.score_calibration: per_case_minmax independently for query relevance and every role prompt

generic_role_prompts.direct_answer_support: Find evidence that directly supports a correct answer to the question.
generic_role_prompts.entity_and_scope: Find evidence that identifies the relevant entity, scope, time, or conditions for the answer.
generic_role_prompts.corroborating_evidence: Find independent evidence that corroborates or completes the answer.
generic_role_prompts.contradiction_detection: Find evidence useful for detecting conflicting, false, or misleading claims about the answer.

verification_role_prompts.claim_support: Find evidence that directly supports this claim as true.
verification_role_prompts.claim_refutation: Find evidence that directly contradicts or refutes this claim as false.
verification_role_prompts.entity_bridge: Find evidence that identifies an entity or relation needed to connect this claim to another document.
verification_role_prompts.cross_document_chain: Find evidence that corroborates or completes a multi-document reasoning chain for this claim.

frozen_scoring.reason_for_zero_mix: Keep task-specific role logits distinct from direct query relevance so the experiment measures role-prompt increment rather than a built-in copy of the baseline score.

frozen_selector.shared_frc_rule: Use the identical v34 thresholded role-coverage greedy rule for generic and verification role families; threshold 0.55, identical relevance term, feasibility scan, and candidate-id tie break.
frozen_selector.hard_constraints: selected chunk count <= 5 and total token_count <= requested budget

frozen_metrics.document_precision: unique selected candidate documents that are gold supporting documents / unique selected candidate documents
frozen_metrics.document_recall: gold supporting-document units covered by at least one selected chunk / all gold supporting-document units
frozen_metrics.document_evidence_f1: harmonic mean of document precision and recall, zero when both are zero

stopping_rule.gate_policy: This cross-domain document-selection experiment cannot by itself change Gate 2, authorize CANARY/DEFAULT, reproduce SetR, or establish flood-domain effectiveness.
